title: Summerlin tan stucco retail
notes: Tan stucco body, slightly darker cut-sandstone trim zone (bands, columns, coping), dark bronze storefront: gray glass with black-glass mullions every 2nd column (Detail pp.3-5), gray concrete backing 1 block behind (Detail p.5; not black behind gray). Column texture alternates two near-identical sandstones by rows (Detail p.24). Colour before texture (Detail p.30).
